correction: A created release can be unusable even though every step reported success: glab 1.52 records the uploaded file's link URL without the project namespace (https://host/-/project/<id>/uploads/<secret>/<name>), and GitLab's asset download route redirects to exactly that URL, so the asset 404s for every consumer and for the pipeline's own read-back. Rewrite the link to the API uploads route (/api/v4/projects/<id>/uploads/<secret>/<name>) before the read-back, idempotently, and fetch the read-back through the route a consumer clicks rather than through a copy obtained another way.
